purpose: Frozen legal-support/fall-contact boundary and explicit MuJoCo contact-parameter classification with bounded deferrals.

decisions.value: only the active plantar heel / forefoot / toe regions of either foot may create valid floor support
decisions.notes: Landing may legitimately begin toe/forefoot-first before heel.

decisions.value: pelvis, HAT, thigh, shank or bar contact with the floor is prohibited/fall contact; body/bar-floor contact is a task failure
decisions.notes: No disabled collision shell may simultaneously serve as evidence for a prohibited-contact claim.

excluded_with_rationale: adjacent anatomical parent-child pairs where self-contact is impossible

decisions.sensitivity: representative-pose collision audit mandatory: standing, deep legal countermovement, takeoff extension, flight, touchdown, landing absorption, recovery

decisions.value: no artificial root limits, root springs, root damping, hidden supports or catch planes; root DOF passives are exactly zero

value.rationale: plantar-floor contacts carry sliding + torsional friction authority; other contacts are declared nominal

decisions.sensitivity: condim sensitivity must be executed if enabled dimensions differ from nominal
decisions.notes: Contact authority is never reduced to one scalar friction coefficient.

decisions.locator: sports shoe/surface measurements span materially different values by outsole and method
decisions.notes: 0.90 is not a measured universal athletic-surface truth.

value.ownership: RES-84 owns the numeric value and its solution-verification justification
value.qualification_domain_frozen_here: must be selected by solution verification, declared in candidate identity, sensitivity-tested, and shown not to create artificial spin or yaw-drift authority

decisions.notes: Deferral is bounded: value + sensitivity domain are frozen by RES-84, not silently chosen at run time.

value.rationale: nominal foot contact is box-like; rolling friction is not needed for box-floor contact
value.condition: if any round/capsule plantar contact geometry is introduced, a numeric rolling-friction value becomes DEFERRED_TO_LATER_AUTHORITY (RES-84) and must be sensitivity-tested

decisions.sensitivity: required if round contact geoms are introduced
decisions.notes: Nominal zero is a statement about the nominal geometry, not a claim about shoes.

value.margin: numeric value DEFERRED_TO_LATER_AUTHORITY (RES-84); semantics frozen: included in the takeoff clearance guard max(2 mm, margin + verified numerical/penetration allowance)
value.gap: numeric value DEFERRED_TO_LATER_AUTHORITY (RES-84); semantics frozen: zero nominal or declared and included in clearance accounting

decisions.sensitivity: RES-84 must seal exact evaluated values in the candidate identity
decisions.notes: Margin/gap may never silently shrink the takeoff clearance definition.

value.provisional_rule: any provisional standing-contact setting is labeled PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL and cannot silently become final candidate authority

decisions.notes: Extremely stiff contact is not automatically more physical.

value.provisional_rule: provisional values labeled PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL; final values selected by solution verification, never by labeling them human soft tissue

frozen_constraints: penetration allowance declared in the clearance guard
the historical project candidate hard cap 0.010 m remains RES-82-owned and is NOT re-frozen here

decisions.locator: solution verification; RES-82 project hard-rule candidate
decisions.notes: Penetration evidence must be reported raw, not only aggregated.

decisions.value: final candidate must show no material dependence on the declared contact/friction sensitivity and no uncontrolled slip, artificial sticking, friction-cone saturation or solver-dependent qualitative reversal
decisions.sensitivity: material qualitative reversal blocks final authority until explained or narrowed
decisions.notes: No numerical contact choice may be presented as a sports-science measurement.
